description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Two Secretaries to Ministries with effect from 21.05.2025
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel appointments (Secretaries to Ministries) with named individuals and their basic titles/designations, but does NOT include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. It fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazettes) - appointments of specific individuals with basic titles only.
